text: The heritage text describes the first distillation of fermented milk as arz; other sources here call arz the second distillation of arkhi. The source gives no temperatures or strength for further rounds.

steps.name: distil
steps.note: The cooling water is changed 2–4 times per run, depending on how far the milk has fermented; half the top-pot water is replaced with cold when it boils.
